user.title: Connect to Google Wifi
user.description: Open https://accounts.google.com/EmbeddedSetup in a browser, sign in to the Google account that owns or manages the Wifi network, then copy the full `oauth_token` cookie value (including `oauth2_4/`). The cookie is only used during setup and is not stored.

data_description.email: The Google account that has access to the Wifi network.
data_description.oauth_token: The complete value of the `oauth_token` cookie from accounts.google.com.

network.title: Choose Wifi network
network.description: Choose the Google Wifi network to add. Run the integration setup again if you want to add another network from the same account.

reauth_confirm.title: Reconnect Google Wifi
reauth_confirm.description: Authentication for {email} needs to be renewed. Get a fresh `oauth_token` from https://accounts.google.com/EmbeddedSetup.

error.cannot_connect: Could not connect to the Google Wifi Foyer service.
error.invalid_auth: Google authentication failed. Get a fresh oauth_token from EmbeddedSetup and try again.
error.no_networks: No Google Wifi networks were returned for this account.

abort.already_configured: This Google Wifi network is already configured.
abort.reauth_required: Authentication needs to be started again.
abort.reauth_successful: Google Wifi authentication was renewed successfully.
